# Background

Starlette includes a `BackgroundTask` class for in-process background tasks.

A background task should be attached to a response, and will run only once the response has been sent.

### Background Task

Used to add a single background task to a response. [...] ### BackgroundTasks

Used to add multiple background tasks to a response.

Signature: `BackgroundTasks(tasks=[])`

search_result.summary:
Tasks are executed using Starlette’s `run_in_threadpool` function
   This utilizes anyio’s thread pool with a default limit of 40 concurrent threads
   The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) still applies, limiting true parallelism for CPU-bound tasks

Takeaway: Async functions are better for lightweight, I/O-heavy tasks. Sync functions work too, but keep in mind they use a limited thread pool.

## Task Execution Flow

The background task execution follows this precise sequence: [...] Tasks run in the same event loop as your FastAPI application
   They are scheduled and executed sequentially after the response is sent
   No separate threads are created — everything happens in the main application thread

search_result.title: Background Tasks - FastAPI
search_result.summary:
It is imported/included directly into FastAPI so that you can import it from `fastapi` and avoid accidentally importing the alternative `BackgroundTask` (without the `s` at the end) from `starlette.background`.

By only using `BackgroundTasks` (and not `BackgroundTask`), it's then possible to use it as a path operation function parameter and have FastAPI handle the rest for you, just like when using the `Request` object directly. [...] It's still possible to use `BackgroundTask` alone in FastAPI, but you have to create the object in your code and return a Starlette `Response` including it.

You can see more details in Starlette's official docs for Background Tasks.

## Caveat¶

If you need to perform heavy background computation and you don't necessarily need it to be run by the same process (for example, you don't need to share memory, variables, etc), you might benefit from using other bigger tools like Celery. [...] In this example, the messages will be written to the `log.txt` file after the response is sent.

If there was a query in the request, it will be written to the log in a background task.

And then another background task generated at the path operation function will write a message using the `email` path parameter.

## Technical Details¶

The class `BackgroundTasks` comes directly from `starlette.background`.

Both `run_in_executor` and `run_in_threadpool` are used to run synchronous code (also called blocking code) in an asynchronous application without blocking the event loop. `run_in_executor` is a relatively low-level operation, originating in Python’s `asyncio` library, whereas `run_in_threadpool` comes from Starlette, the ASGI framework underlying FastAPI. # 开源性能计算新利器：VectorFlow如何重塑电商数据处理效率

2026-09-07 

开源性能计算 VectorFlow 电商系统优化 实时数据处理 向量化引擎

> VectorFlow是一款2026年新晋的开源高性能计算框架，专为实时数据流处理与向量化计算设计。本文深入解析其核心功能，并探讨如何在电商系统中落地，从个性化推荐到实时库存管理，展示其如何以低延迟、高吞吐的优势，助力电商企业应对大促峰值与复杂数据挑战，同时保持开源生态的灵活性与成本效益。

在电商行业，数据就是生命线。从用户点击到库存同步，每毫秒的延迟都可能转化为订单流失。2026年，一款名为VectorFlow的开源性能计算产品悄然走红，它并非传统的数据库或消息队列，而是一个专为实时向量化计算打造的高性能计算引擎。VectorFlow由欧洲一家技术社区发起，核心定位是“让复杂计算像流水一样自然”，它融合了SIMD指令集优化、内存计算与流式处理，使得开发者能够以极简API处理每秒数百万级的数据事件。
